key_insight: The Generalized Mean-Field Ising (GMFI) family combines dense, inhomogeneous interactions with exact ground-state solutions, enabling scalable optimization benchmarks.
engineering_relevance: Known exact solutions provide reference targets for evaluating quantum and classical optimizers at system sizes beyond exact diagonalization.
method: Derive exact ground states using hidden low-dimensional structure.
Classify system sizes and ground-state degeneracies through number theory.
Evaluate quantum annealing, QAOA, imaginary-time evolution, and classical optimization methods.
evidence_signal: The study includes D-Wave experiments and reports pronounced system-size-dependent oscillations in the quantum-annealing gap, despite an expected overall decrease with size.
watch_item: Exact solvability does not imply easy optimization, and the abstract provides no quantitative evidence of quantum advantage.
paper_title: Generalized Mean-Field Ising Model as a Benchmark Family with Exact Solutions
